references.text: Abraham obeyed God's command immediately and circumcised Ishmael and all the men in his household on that same day. Verse 26 summarizes and confirms this action.
God's covenant with Abraham included the command that all males in his household be circumcised, which Abraham obediently carried out in verses 23-27.
Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, in accordance with God's command to perform circumcision on the eighth day.
Stephen refers to God's covenant of circumcision with Abraham and that Abraham circumcised Isaac, showing how the covenant continued from Abraham to his descendants.
Paul explains that Abraham received circumcision as a sign and seal of the righteousness he had by faith even before he was circumcised.
